details: The sole interaction is a pointermove handler using Delaunay.find() plus lightweight attribute updates on a single highlight circle and tooltip innerHTML — no full data joins or DOM re-renders occur per event, so no update storm. The Pointer Events API (pointermove/pointerleave) unifies mouse and touch natively, there are no cross-view dispatches, no transitions to interrupt, and the scales are static (no resize logic), so stale closures are not a risk.
